disposition_reason: Primary flame AAS data for metals in pollen provisions from Osmia bicornis nests at 27 sites; habitat means and extremes are printed in the text, with full values only in Figure 2.

study.design: Field biomonitoring with trap nests of the solitary bee Osmia bicornis in three habitat types (8 berry, 10 orchard, 9 urban sites)
study.period_text: 2017; pollen collected once, three weeks after bees began flying (nests placed mid-April)
study.method: Flame AAS (Varian Spectra AA-110/220) after HNO3 microwave digestion; triplicate measurements
study.qa: CRMs IAEA-336 and BCR CRM 482 used for verification; recoveries not reported

unresolved: Habitat Cd means are printed only as '0.06-0.07 mg/kg' without assigning values to habitats; not extracted as separate means.
Text ordering 'Fe > Mn > Cd > Cu > Zn > Ni > Pb > Ag' places Cd above Cu, which contradicts the printed Cd (about 0.06 mg/kg) and Cu (about 10 mg/kg) values.
All other per-habitat values and variability are figure-only (Figure 2); not read off the chart.
Bee-body results (Figure 3, Section 3.3) are biological samples and are not extracted.
LOD printed as 1 ppb without stating whether it refers to solution or sample.
